subject: Re: POC next steps and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: POC next steps and success criteria

Thanks again for the time today, Alex - great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of call:
- Primary POC scope: document summarization + semantic search for internal knowledge base (initial 6-week trial).
- Success criteria we agreed on: 
  * Avg. extractive summarization F1 >= 0.78 on the 200-sample eval set;
  * Query latency P95 < 180ms at target concurrency (~25 qps);
  * Integration with Acme SSO and audit logging enabled.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Redwood to deliver MAP + credentials for sandbox (Marissa) - by 2026-08-18.
- SE to share test harness and eval scripts (Mateo) - by 2026-08-19.
- Acme to provide sample dataset + success-test queries (Alex/Priya) - by 2026-08-20.

Notes and open questions:
- We'll provision a dedicated test pool for the POC to ensure stable latency.
- If you anticipate increased throughput or additional use cases, please flag now so we can size appropriately.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the initial success criteria document. If this looks right I'll finalize and send the official MAP.

Next call: sync on Wed 8/19 to confirm dataset ingestion and gating criteria.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx, POC_Success_Criteria.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: POC next steps and success criteria

Marissa - thanks for the recap and clear plan. Quick update from our side after internal review: 

1) We'd like to add a second use case to the POC: reranking for search result relevance (we have a web search front-end that needs better ordering).
2) Because reranking is critical to our product roadmap, we want to include a combined success metric: relevance lift >= 8% over current baseline (A/B on 1k queries) in addition to the summarization metrics.
3) This will likely increase the dataset size and the throughput requirements (we're estimating ~50 qps for the reranking workload during peak tests).

Can Redwood accommodate this scope change mid-trial, or do we need to extend timelines / change resource allocation? We want to keep the POC to ~6 weeks total if possible but are open to an extension if necessary.

If you want to discuss, I'm free this afternoon 2-4pm PT.

Best,
Alex
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme-corp.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: POC next steps and success criteria - reranking plan

Hi all - quick plan from the SE side. We can support reranking in the same POC but with a couple of adjustments: 

Proposed technical approach:
- Provision an additional model endpoint optimized for reranking (same model family but different batching config).
- Use streaming/mini-batching to maintain low-latency for the summarization path while parallelizing reranking load.
- Increase test pool to 2x GPUs during peak A/B tests (temporary burst capacity).

Impact to success criteria/timeline:
- Add combined relevance lift >= 8% (A/B, 1k queries) as a pass condition.
- Expected effort: 1 week to add reranking harness and ingest ranking dataset; 1 week for integration and smoke tests; then 2 weeks of evaluation (concurrent with summarization tests).
- Conservative schedule: add 2 weeks to the current plan (total POC ~8 weeks) OR keep 6 weeks by overlapping integration work with initial ingestion and accepting a tighter schedule.

What I need from Acme:
- Reranking dataset + baseline labels (preferable CSV with query, candidate set, baseline score) - delivery by 2026-08-20 to hit 8-week timeline.
- Confirmation on target concurrency (you mentioned ~50 qps).

Commercial note:
- If Acme wants guaranteed burst capacity we should reflect that in MAP pricing - Stephanie, can you prepare a short amendment?

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the plan.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

Subject: Updated MAP and next steps - Acme POC (reranking added)

Alex - thanks for the quick turnaround on requirements. Per our internal review we've updated the MAP to add the reranking use case and the combined success criteria. Summary of the agreed re-baseline: 

- POC scope: summarization + reranking (reranking A/B lift target >= 8% on 1k queries).
- Schedule: 8-week timeline (adds 2 weeks to initial plan). Key milestones: 
  * Week 1: dataset ingestion (summaries + reranking CSV)
  * Week 2: SE integration and harness change (Mateo)
  * Weeks 3-4: concurrent evaluation smoke tests
  * Weeks 5-8: A/B testing and final evaluation
- Ownership: Redwood SE (Mateo) leads integration; Marissa owns MAP and commercial coordination; Acme owns dataset delivery and baseline definition.
- Pricing: MAP addendum for temporary burst capacity attached (Stephanie) - one-time POC uplift fee noted.

Please review the attached MAP_v2 and the addendum. If everything looks good, please reply "ACK" and we'll send the DocuSign for signatures and schedule the ingestion call.

Thanks \u2014 looking forward to getting started.
